title: A consumable carrier must be replenished before reuse
summary: A finite-resource model says one operation consumes the active carrier; a later operation can use it only after an explicit replenishment marker. A reusable-carrier model allows repeated operations without replenishment.

design.unit: ordered operation records containing a carrier, first use, later use, and candidate replenishment marker
design.prediction: After one carrier-consuming operation, a second operation without replenishment should lack that carrier or use a new carrier; inserting replenishment should restore eligibility.
design.countermodel: The same sequence could result from missing records, editorial omission, or context-conditioned lexical conventions without the proposed functional rule.
design.falsifier: The same carrier supports repeated operations with no replenishment, or a replenishment marker appears without changing later carrier eligibility under matched records.
design.principal_risk: Carrier identity and consumption are unavailable. Near IDEA000038/046 and carrier-transfer families, but the restriction is resource exhaustion and recovery rather than argument inheritance or scope.
